headline: On October 14, 2014: Serbia vs. Albania Match Abandoned
captionCards: Drone with Albanian banner sparked chaos on the pitch
Match abandonment underscored ethnic tensions in the Balkans
instagramCaption:
A UEFA Euro 2016 qualifier ends in chaos.\nDuring the match at Partizan Stadium in Belgrade, Serbian fans chanted and threw flares. A drone carrying an Albanian nationalist banner appeared, leading to a brawl. The match was abandoned after 42 minutes, and Albania was awarded the win. This event highlighted the deep-seated tensions between the two nations. Why do you think this match was so contentious?\nFollow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
